title.zh: SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading of Tokenized NMS Stock and Request for Comment
title.en: SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading of Tokenized NMS Stock and Request for Comment

current_state.zh: The SEC issued a temporary conditional exemptive order allowing Tokenized Securities Venues to trade tokenized NMS stock without registering as exchanges, and opened a public comment period on the framework.
current_state.en: The SEC issued a temporary conditional exemptive order allowing Tokenized Securities Venues to trade tokenized NMS stock without registering as exchanges, and opened a public comment period on the framework.
